evaluation.setup: One SceneFun3D Development scene (visit 420683, video 42445137); task-grounded Grounding DINO prompt; posed ARKit RGB plus native depth; authorized parent OBB; evaluator functional truth loaded only after provider sealing.
evaluation.effect: SC11 multi-view aggregation improved functional-proposal recall from 8/10 to 10/10, legal task commits from 3/6 to 4/6, mean target-set recall from 0.50 to 0.8333, and wrong parts from 8 to 2; proposal precision was 0.8462.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Narrow one-scene privileged-parent posed-RGB-D Development evidence only. It does not establish open-vocabulary or phone-camera coverage, exact-instance acquisition, reachability, orientation, arrival, completion, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.
